files.README.md:
# Marrowgate Transit - fare export

The fare-export script writes a scratch file while it assembles the day's rows, and the
scheduler stops it when the export window closes.
The cleanup lines the team uses are in ops/cleanup-cards.tsv.
files.notes/run-notes.txt:
Run notes:
The script sometimes stops before the scratch file exists, so the cleanup has to survive a
missing file without reporting an error.

turns.prompt: Marrowgate Transit's fare-export script writes a scratch file at /var/tmp/fare-export.work. The script sometimes stops before that file has been created, and the cleanup itself must not report an error. Give the line that removes the scratch file when the script finishes, whether it finishes by reaching its last command or by exiting early because a command failed. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
